CustomField.description: Identifies the activity source as Yesware, LinkedIn, or Marketo.
CustomField.formula:
IF((ywr__Yesware_TotalCall__c >= 1), "Yesware", IF((ywr__Yesware_Meeting__c >= 1), "Yesware",
IF(BEGINS(Subject,"Message Sent:"), "Yesware", IF(BEGINS(Subject,"InMail sent from Sales Navigator"), "LinkedIn", IF(BEGINS(Subject,"Message sent from Sales Navigator"), "LinkedIn", IF(BEGINS(Subject,"Was Sent Email:"), "Marketo", IF(BEGINS(Subject,"Email:"), "Yesware", IF(( ywr__Yesware_Sent__c >= 1), "Yesware",
IF(BEGINS(Subject,"Message Opened:"), "Yesware", IF(BEGINS(Subject,"Opened Email:"), "Marketo", IF((yw__YeswareOpens__c >= 1), "Yesware",
IF(BEGINS(Subject,"Reply:"), "Yesware", IF((yw__YeswareReplies__c >= 1), "Yesware",
IF(BEGINS(Subject,"Link Clicked in Message:"), "Yesware", IF(BEGINS(Subject,"Smart Link View from Sales Navigator"), "LinkedIn", IF(BEGINS(Subject,"Clicked Link in Email:"), "Marketo", IF((yw__YeswareLinkClicks__c >= 1), "Yesware",
IF(BEGINS(Subject,"Attachment Opened in Message:"), "Yesware",
IF(BEGINS(Subject,"Presentation Viewed in Message:"), "Yesware",
IF(BEGINS(Subject,"YW Custom"), "Yesware", IF(BEGINS(Subject,"Message Sync:"), "Yesware",
IF(BEGINS(Subject,"Notes from Sales Navigator"), "LinkedIn",
IF(BEGINS(Subject,"Bounce Received:"), "Yesware", IF(BEGINS(Subject,"Unresolved Email:"), "Yesware", IF((Subject = "Bounce Received: Delivery Status Notification (Failure)"), "Yesware",
IF(BEGINS(Subject,"Filled Out Form"), "Marketo",
"Task"))))))))))))))))))))))))))
CustomField.label: Activity Source
